evidence: Optimizes core serialization primitives and witness data structures shared across consensus and node utilities.
rationale: Directly deserializing witness data and inlining compact size decoding yields up to a 10x speedup when processing worst-case blocks packed with millions of tiny witness elements. Benchmarks cited by the author demonstrate receipt-to-accept/reject time dropping from 128ms to 14ms for synthetic 2.0M element blocks.
